# KPM Line Feeding Operations Platform

> Real-time logistics, material dispatch, GPS fleet tracking, and digital delivery confirmation platform.

## Overview
KPM Line Feeding is a mission-critical web and mobile operational platform designed for tracking and managing material movement (Kartu Pemindahan Material / KPM) between workshops and manufacturing sites.

## System Architecture
- Frontend: Vue 3 Single Page Application with TailwindCSS and Leaflet GPS Radar.
- Mobile: Vue 3 Android PWA with Camera capture and GPS background reporting.
- Backend: Google Apps Script REST API with spreadsheet persistence and Firebase Realtime Database live tracking.
- API Deployment ID: AKfycbz1XwsnPkZ7-gqV8CMgeg0GWpp6jLn13nR_CTqSWppVgYwr4IpqSIA710W8OUQz43g2IA

## User Roles & Capabilities
- **Administrator**:
  - Issue new KPM delivery orders with item specifications and workshops.
  - Live fleet radar map monitoring with smooth motion vehicle interpolation.
  - Material editing prior to vehicle departure.
  - Archive completed KPMs.
- **Driver / Field Personnel**:
  - View assigned active KPM deliveries.
  - 1-Click GPS Navigation routing to destination workshop.
  - Capture and upload departure / arrival photo evidence.
  - Automatic live GPS coordinate broadcasting.

## Endpoints & Pages
- `GET /`: Unified Application Portal (Admin & Driver)
- `GET /kpm`: Admin Dashboard & Fleet Monitoring
- `GET /kpm/personel`: Driver / Field Personnel Portal
- `POST /api?action=login`: Credential, Google, and QR Code authentication
- `GET /api?action=getMasterData`: Workshops, PICs, and UOM reference data
- `GET /api?action=getMonitoring`: Active and archived KPM statuses
- `GET /api?action=getDeliveries`: Driver active delivery queues
- `POST /api?action=createKpm`: Create new material transfer order
- `POST /api?action=updateStatus`: Driver status update (Berangkat / Tiba with photo and GPS)
- `POST /api?action=editLatestKpmItems`: Adjust material items before departure
- `POST /api?action=archiveKpm`: Archive completed shipments
